segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Hi, we're the Chartitable team. This is Chartitable. Not charitable. Chart-it-able. If your donation does good, you should be able to chart it. Not with an actual chart. We checked, nobody wants a chart. It's a pun. We're very proud of it.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Here's me giving to a small food pantry the normal way. I give twenty five dollars and I feel great. A month later I go back to the website and, nothing. Same photo, same Donate Now button. Where did my money go? Did it buy a pizza for the intern? I'll never know. Black hole.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: And it's not just me. Less than half of donors ever give again: forty three point three percent, in the latest Fundraising Effectiveness Project data. Charities lose billions a year this way, and small pantries have no fundraising staff to write you back. The bucket leaks because donors never see what happened next.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Chartitable closes the loop. One line of script on the charity's own website, and when a donor comes back, the page changes for them: what the pooled gifts did, their share, one next step. Claude writes the story, and a fact checker rejects any number it was never given.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Okay. Same donation as before, now with Chartitable.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Same pantry. First, a stranger visits. Nothing is personalized, it's just their normal website. Now I give twenty five dollars. Test mode, no real money. And when I land back on the site, it knows I just gave.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: One week later. The pantry's staff keep logging what happened. And when my pooled share crosses a milestone, I get a note.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I click through, and the page rearranged itself around me. The records are what staff logged. The estimate says about, because gifts are pooled and we never claim one specific dollar.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now watch. Staff post: served eighty meals. I don't reload anything. Within seconds the page shows it, and my estimated share moves.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: And when I want to give again, one click, and it welcomes me back as the same donor.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Before: a page that never changes. After: what the gifts did, my share, labeled as an estimate, and one clear next step.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Donors stay when they can see the impact. Chartitable makes your giving chart-it-able. Everything you saw is labeled: records are facts, estimates say about, and when we don't know, we say less. Thank you. Please clap. Please fund us.
